summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release reporting results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026, and declaring a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.80 per share payable September 16, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation transaction. It also notes a share repurchase plan of up to $20 million announced in May 2022, with approximately 480,460 shares repurchased for about $11.36 million, representing 6.8% of outstanding shares. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is involved. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-3 registration statement.
